svg.title: How close is the direction from P-wave motion?
svg.desc: Left: histogram of direction errors for 271 station-quake pairs. Right: error against distance.
svg.text: How close is the direction from P-wave motion?
how far off the direction was
Each dot is one station and one quake
13 Utah quakes (M2.5 to M5.7), 1–5 Hz, first half second of P. Clear motion: linearity above 0.8 and up/away above 0.5.
